body: Found during issue 665 (V1-0976) on 2026-10-07. The public repository carries a private adopter's product name in 11 tracked paths at origin/main 0b45b052: docs/specs/README.md, docs/specs/application-flow-understanding-v1.md, documentation-corpus-v1.md, external-evidence-provider-v1.md, typescript-javascript-affected-adapter-v0.md, docs/BUILD-LOG.md, conformance/frontier-v0/runner_impl.go, internal/doccorpus/behavior.go, internal/migrationratchet/compare_test.go, and internal/liveverify/affected/typescript/playwright_*_test.go (the name is in the file name). Expected: private adopter detail stays out of the public repo and specs cite GitHub issues instead. Actual: the name appears in prose, code and one file name. docs/BUILD-LOG.md is closed (decision 0423); decide whether to redact it or record the exception.

completion.reason: Delivered in batch P (PR beamfall/corvint#704, merged 2026-10-09 at main dd90cfa6): the remaining adopter-name mentions in docs/BUILD-LOG.md are redacted under a recorded privacy exception.
